correctness.rationale: Root-of-unity invariance orthogonally decomposes the degree<=n polynomial space into z^m Q_m(z^q), m=0..q-1; substituting u=r^q produces q Jacobi L2 weights u^(A_m-1)(1-u)^alpha/B(A0,alpha+1). Standard exact Jacobi norms h_{j,m}, with the j=0 Beta case kept separate, give the stated two-variable finite kernel. At the origin only m=0 remains and endpoint values telescope to the Gamma quotient, including n<q. Gamma ratios yield growth n^[2(beta+1)/q] with q factor. Compact-uniform Mehler-Heine/hypergeometric majorants bound each block and make the first j<epsilon N slice vanish as epsilon^[2A_m], while the rest Riemann-sums to the displayed Bessel integral. Since 2A_m-4m/q=2A0, every cyclic block survives. K(0,0) asymptotic cancels B(A0,alpha+1) and proves exact outer-alpha independence of the normalized locally uniform limit, value one at origin. Independent exact rational Gram checks for q=3 alpha=beta=0 corroborated finite block identities; finite tests do not prove the limit.
